messages:
Maria Chen: quick thread to consolidate postmortem follow-ups from the 03/21 outage — focused on rollout/canary/flag controls. I'll list proposed action items; please ack and claim ownership.
Arjun Patel: ack. can we add a short test harness for auto-rollback behavior? want deterministic CI tests before we enable in prod.
Maria Chen: yes — TODO 1: auto-rollback test harness (CI + canary sim). owner: @Arjun. target: 2w. priority: high.
Tom Reyes: I can own Blast Radius defaults and flag scoping. proposal: default rollout=0.5% for new flags, 5% for internal builds. also add per-flag emergency_quarantine boolean.
Priya Kaur: I'll drive the emergency_quarantine feature. owner: @Priya. plan: feature-flag schema change + migration doc. ETA: 10 business days.
Arjun Patel: for the harness, I'll add a simulated traffic replay mode + a small set of deterministic regressions. sample config: ```json
{"canary": {"sample_rate": 0.01, "metric_thresholds": {"error_rate": 0.02}, "rollback_action": "disable_flag"}}
```
Ava - SRE: add a runbook step: when auto-rollback triggers, alert paging policy must include the owner + oncall. also run a containment drill after changes go live. I can schedule the drill.
Maria Chen: TODO 2: rollout telemetry enrichment (per-flag token breakdown + 1min anomaly hook). owner: @Tom. ETA: 3w.
Tom Reyes: acked. will add a small infra metric (flag_id, bucket, p95_latency, error_rate) and wire to alert rules.
Priya Kaur: TODO 3: gated rollout orchestration CLI — add `--quarantine-wait` and `--force-rollback` flags and an API for manual quarantine. owner: @Priya. ETA: 2w.
Arjun Patel: TODO 4: CI gating for auto-rollback codepath. add unit + e2e, and a simple chaos test to ensure rollback runs under partial failures. owner: @Arjun. ETA: 1.5w.
Maria Chen: TODO 5: postmortem pattern tracker — gather 3 incidents in 90d to propose default guardrails. owner: @Ava. ETA: 30d.
Ava - SRE: I'll own the tracker and add retro tags in the incident board. scheduling drill for next Tue.
deploy-bot: deploy 232d9c -> staging by @Arjun succeeded :white_check_mark:
Tom Reyes: one more: add a small scoring heuristic for blast-radius risk at rollout time (predictive risk score). owner: @Tom. ETA: 4w.
Maria Chen: action owners summary: Arjun (auto-rollback test harness + CI gating), Priya (emergency_quarantine + CLI), Tom (telemetry + blast-radius defaults + risk score), Ava (postmortem tracker + drill). please put PR links and exact commit ids in this thread when open.
Priya Kaur: ack. will drop PR link here when ready.
Arjun Patel: ack. starting branch `canary/auto-rollback-harness`.
Maria Chen: thanks all. weekly check-in on this thread Friday 09:00 PT. if you hit blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
